class.name: OcgTransferTransferoutput
class.brief_description: A TransferOutput is a Tool which manages the transfer of entities created by an Interface, stored in an InterfaceModel, into a set of Objects suitable for an Application Objects to be transferred are given, by method Transfer (which calls Transfer from TransientProcess) A default action is available to get all roots of the Model Result is given as a TransferIterator (see TransferProcess) Also, it is possible to pilot directly the TransientProcess
class.description: ! A TransferOutput is a Tool which manages the transfer of ! entities created by an Interface, stored in an InterfaceModel, ! into a set of Objects suitable for an Application ! Objects to be transferred are given, by method Transfer ! (which calls Transfer from TransientProcess) ! A default action is available to get all roots of the Model ! Result is given as a TransferIterator (see TransferProcess) ! Also, it is possible to pilot directly the TransientProcess

method.name: TransientProcess
method.description: Returns the TransientProcess used to work

method.name: Transfer
method.description: Transfer checks that all taken Entities come from the same Model, then calls Transfer from TransientProcess

method.name: TransferRoots_2
method.description: Runs transfer on the roots of the Interface Model The Roots are computed with a ShareFlags created from a Protocol given as Argument

method.name: TransferRoots_1
method.description: Runs transfer on the roots of the Interface Model Remark : the Roots are computed with a ShareFlags created from the Active Protocol

method.name: ModelForStatus
method.description: Fills a Model with the list determined by ListForStatus This model starts from scratch (made by NewEmptyModel from the current Model), then is filled by AddWithRefs
